title: Snowflake Cookies
description: These snowflake cookies are easy to make with pantry staples; have fun decorating with cookie icing and colored sugar for beautiful Christmas gifts.

steps.text: Beat sugar and shortening with an electric mixer in a large bowl until smooth. Beat one egg into butter mixture, then beat in remaining eggs and vanilla. Add flour and salt; stir until dough is just combined. Wrap dough in plastic wrap and chill for at least 1 hour.
When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Roll dough on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of 1/8 inch. Cut dough into desired shapes with a cookie cutter and place 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake in the preheated oven until edges are golden brown, about 6 to 8 minutes. Cool briefly on baking sheets, then remove to wire racks to cool completely before decorating.
